purpose: Frozen P per proposal v4 §5.1 INV-P-1: the union of subset-(a) (calibrated BIB 4-dim behavior vector) and subset-(b) (8 C12 non-target axes), with explicit non-collapse attestation.

binding.subset_b_artifact: inputs/preservation-dimensions-subset-b.json (8 C12 non-target axes, additional preservation gates)

non_collapse_attestation.attestation_text: P is the DISJOINT UNION of subset-(a) and subset-(b). Subset-(a) is evaluated under the BIB 4-dim Manhattan aggregate criterion (G_pres_a + G_pres_b per v0.1 §11.2); subset-(b) is evaluated as 8 independently-gated binary/subjective axes. The two subsets are not concatenated into a 12-dim Manhattan. Axes sharing names across subsets (selection_significance, end_of_report_synthesis, lifetime_framing, factual_discipline) are scored under their respective subset's criteria and reported as distinct gates. Factual discipline appears as the 4th subset-(a) dim AND as C12-7 axis; these are independently scored under different criteria and reported separately.
